title: Who else is drop watching?
body:
curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pulls/27742 | jq -c '{draft,state,merged}' for r in unsloth/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF; do echo "== $r" curl -s "https://huggingface.co/api/models/$r" \ | jq -r '.siblings[]?.rfilename' \ | awk -F/ 'NF>1{print $1; next}{print "(root)"}' | sort | uniq -c done

With dual flashes released today, I'm watching for suitable uploads:

submitted by /u/devino21
summaryZh: 用户通过脚本监控llama.cpp及HuggingFace上的新模型发布，重点关注GLM-5.3-Flash和Qwen3.8-Flash的量化版本。
